title: Tiny, cute roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Boot body -->
  <path d="M30 30 Q30 22 38 22 L55 22 Q62 22 65 28 L70 48 Q72 56 66 60 L40 60 Q32 60 30 52 Z" fill="#e84393"/>
  <!-- Boot lighter panel -->
  <path d="M36 32 Q36 27 41 27 L55 27 Q59 27 61 31 L65 46 Q65 51 60 51 L42 51 Q37 51 36 46 Z" fill="#fd79a8"/>

  <line x1="40" y1="33" x2="58" y2="33" stroke="#ffeaa7" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="38" x2="60" y2="38" stroke="#ffeaa7" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="41" y1="43" x2="61" y2="43" stroke="#ffeaa7" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cuff tongs -->
  <rect x="45" y="18" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#d63031"/>
  <!-- Sole -->
  <path d="M28 52 L70 52 Q74 52 74 57 L74 62 Q74 66 70 66 L32 66 Q28 66 28 62 Z" fill="#0984e3"/>
  <!-- Heel -->
  <rect x="28" y="62" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#74b9ff"/>
  <!-- Skid stop toe -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="60" r="5" fill="#fdcb6e"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#e17055"/>
  <!-- Axle -->
  <rect x="40" y="68" width="26" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#b2bec3"/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="76" r="7" fill="#00cec9"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="76" r="3" fill="#55efc4"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="7" fill="#00cec9"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="3" fill="#55efc4"/>
  <!-- Wheel hubs -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#fdcb6e"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#fdcb6e"/>
  <!-- Cute face on boot -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="37" r="2" fill="#2d3436"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="37" r="2" fill="#2d3436"/>
  <circle cx="46.7" cy="36.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="54.7" cy="36.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <path d="M47 41 Q50 44 53 41" stroke="#2d3436" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="40" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#ff7675" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="40" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#ff7675" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
